requirement: Render the union of the header, hit windows, and trailer in source order. Copy retained bytes verbatim and replace each nonempty omitted region of the enclosing item with the literal `...`, including a gap at the beginning or end. Insert the marker directly at the cut. When the retained spans cover the item, the excerpt is its original text.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover every obligation in `requirements.sdk.graph.search.omissions`, and their assertions are exact string comparisons. I did not request implementation source, because the expected excerpts follow directly from the requirement text.

- **Union in source order, with verbatim bytes and the literal `...` at each nonempty gap:**
  - `separated_hit_windows_preserve_the_function_declaration` expects `fn run() {...    hit(); hit();\n...    hit();\n...}` with window 4. The header `fn run() {` is kept, the two nearby hits' windows are merged into one span, and the later hit is separate. Interior gaps become `...` directly at the cut, and the trailer `}` is kept.
  - The same test with window 0 expects `fn run() {...hit...hit...hit...}`. This shows header, hit spans and trailer in source order, with markers and no added whitespace.
  - The test compares the whole excerpt, so any reordering, extra whitespace or altered retained bytes would fail.
- **Gap at the beginning and at the end:**
  - `default_windows_retain_128_bytes_on_each_side` expects `...aaa…猫hit猫zzz…...`. That puts a marker at both ends, and the retained multibyte text is copied verbatim. The window-1 case expects `...hit...`.
  - `root_hits_clip_context_to_utf8_boundaries` expects `éhit...` with window 2. The leading gap is empty, so no marker appears there. The trailing gap is nonempty, so a marker appears. This checks that markers are added only for nonempty omitted regions.
- **Retained spans cover the item, so the excerpt is the original text:**
  - `touching_windows_keep_the_contiguous_source` compares `excerpt(...)` with `item.text()` for touching windows. It expects no markers.
  - `root_hits_clip_context_to_utf8_boundaries` checks that an item covered by default windows equals the full source (`needle`, and `éhit猫`).
  - The default-window case in `search_groups_exact_occurrences_and_records_the_selected_declaration` checks two whole-item excerpts.

The tests have no gaps and rely on no testing exemption. Each one carries a `{test}` reference to the subject.
